title: Basement flooding
opening: Water started coming into my basement last night after the storm. I don't know who to call.
answers: It's seeping in along the foundation wall. Still coming in slowly. Not near any outlets.

title: Leaking sink
opening: My kitchen sink has been leaking under the cabinet since this morning.
answers: It's under the kitchen sink, still dripping, I can turn off the valve under the sink.

title: AC not cooling
opening: The AC is running but the house is not cooling. It's 90 degrees inside.
answers: Cooling, not heating. The unit runs but blows warm air. Not completely dead.

title: Roof leak
opening: There's a wet stain on the ceiling in the guest room after last week's storm.
answers: Guest bedroom ceiling. It started after the storm. Not dripping heavily right now.

title: Sparking outlet
opening: The kitchen outlet is sparking when I plug in the toaster.
answers: No smoke and no burning smell now, but it sparked. I stopped using it.

title: Clogged toilet
opening: The downstairs toilet is clogged and won't drain. It almost overflowed.
answers: Downstairs bathroom toilet. Not overflowing now. I shut the water off.

title: Broken water heater
opening: We have no hot water. The water heater is about 12 years old.
answers: Tank water heater in the garage. Completely cold water from every faucet.

title: Pest infestation
opening: I think we have a pest infestation. Seeing droppings in the pantry.
answers: Looks like mice. Indoor, pantry and garage. Started a couple of weeks ago.

title: Vague home problem
opening: Something is wrong with the house and I need someone to look at it.
answers: There's a buzzing sound from a wall near the living room and the lights flicker.

title: Emergency gas smell
opening: I smell gas in the kitchen. It started a few minutes ago.
